title: Ability to use in category templates
description:
**Source:** https://wordpress.org/support/topic/use-on-a-category-template/

**Request:**

This plugin is incredibly useful for creating custom templates with feeds of Repeaters and Relationships. It works great on a Post template. But it doesn't seem to work on a Category template. Here are my steps:

1. Create an ACF field group that has a Relationship field in it and show the field group if the Taxonomy is equal to Category.
2. Edit a category and select a post in the Relationship field.
3. Create an Archive template and have it show when Categories. Add a Loop Grid, select ACF Relationship as the Source, and select the Relationship field created for the Category and save.
4. Go to the Category page that has the Relationship field set. It shows nothing (Nothing Found).

As said, I've confirmed that it works if I create a Relationship field on a field group that is used for Posts and display a Loop Grid on a post page. But it doesn't seem to work for a Category page. Not sure why it would make a difference… Let me know if you can reproduce the issue.
